newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Perm to pick eurobond lead manager by July.
newsitem.headline: Russia Perm to pick eurobond lead manager by July.

text.p: Russia's Perm region, which plans to raise between $50 and $200 million through a Eurobond issue, will choose a lead-manager by next month, an aide to the region's deputy governor said on Friday.
Konstantin Zakharov told Reuters the region had invited applications from CS First Boston and Bank of San Francisco on Friday.
"On June 25 a commission to choose the lead manager and a rating agency will start sitting," Zakharov said. "Give them a week to consider all bids and clear up any misunderstandings."
The region had already received bids from ING-Barings, and Russian banks AB Inkombank and OAO Bank Menatep. It is also expecting a bid from Creditanstalt-Grant.
